item: the server runs only on the stdlib asyncio loop and refuses to start on uvloop
summary: uvicorn's loop=auto picked uvloop, whose resolves and connects bypass the airplane socket guard; _serve now pins loop=asyncio, and lifespan fails closed: on any loop but the stdlib's (a bare python -m uvicorn start picks uvloop) the app refuses to start with fixed words naming the launcher and --loop asyncio. Release line: when started with its own launcher, the app's server now always runs on Python's own event loop, so airplane mode's network guard also covers connections made from that loop; started any other way on a different loop, the app refuses to start and says how to start it.
